JONATHAN PAUL M. LEUSEN, JR., CESC) lv OIC, Office of the Regional Director DILG-Regional Office II Tugegarao City, Cagayan Dear Director Leusen, Jr.: s. 201.2 This has reference to the letter dated 25 August 2017 of Vice Governor Mervin K. Vargas, Jr., of the Province of Cagayan requesting for legal opinion on the propriety of the Order dated 3 August 2017 of the Sangguniang Panglalawigan of Cagayan implementing the Decision reinstating Hon Ting as Punong Barangay of Centro 7, Tuguegarao City, Cagayan. As culled from the 25 August 2017 letter of Vice Governor Vargas, Jr.„ here are the background of this case: "On July 19, 2017, the Sangguniang Panlalavvigan of Cagayan approved Resolution No. 2017-9-568 Adopting the Decision of the Sangguniang Panlalawigan of Cagayan on AC No. 2017-902, entitled, "Jhony Pingad, Complainant-Appellee versus Hilario Larry S Ting, Respondent-Appellant (ADM Case No. 04-2015)", Granting the Appeal Filed by Respondent-Appellant and Ordering the Decision Of the Committee of the Whole of the Sarwuniang Panlungsod of Tuguegarao City dated May II, 2017 Adopted and Approved through City Resolution No. 188-2017 be Reversed and Set Aside, Thereby Reinstating Hilario Larry S. Ting as Punong Barangay of Centro 7 by Operation of Law, a copy of which is hereto attached. Pursuant to such Resolution, an Order to the Local Chief Executive of Tuguegarao City, Hon. Bienvenido C. De Guzman II was issued on August 3, 2017, ordering him to reinstate to the office the Hon. Hilario Larry S. Ting immediately upon his receipt of such order. Copy of the Order is likewise attached. On August 10, 2017, the Sangguniang Panlalawigan received the Hon. De Guzman response to the said Order, stating among others that the Order is premature, hasty and precipitous. We replied via a letter dated August 14, 2017 and we again received a response from him dated 17, 2017. Copies of the letters are hereto attached. "

Based on the facts presented to this Office, the Decision of the Sangguniang Panlungsod of Tuguegarao City, which meted the penalty of six (6) months suspension against Hon. Larry S. Ting was already implemented. Upon appeal with the Sanggunian Panlalawigan, the latter reversed by the Decision of the lower Sanggunian, and thereby ordered Mayor De Guzman II on 3 August 2017 to immediately implement the Decision reinstating Punong Barangay Ting. Hence, this query on the propriety of the Order dated 3 August 2017 of the Sangguniang Panglalawigan Of Cagayan implementing the Decision reinstating Hon Ting as Punong Barangay of Centro 7, Tuguegarao City, Cagayan. To answer your query, may we invite you to the following provisions of the Local Government Code (LGC), viz: SECTION 67. Administrative Appeals. - Decisions in administrative cases may, within thirty (30) days from receipt thereof, be appealed to the following: (a) The Sangguniang Panlalawigan, in the case of decisions of the Sangguniang Panlungsod of component cities and the Sangguniang bayan; SECTION 68. Execution Pending Appeal. - An appeal shall not prevent a decision from becoming final or executory. The respondent shall be considered as having been placed under preventive suspension during the pendency of an appeal in the event he wins such appeal. In the event the appeal results in an exoneration, he shall be paid his salary and such other emoluments during the pendency of the appeal. In addition, Section 131 of the Implementing Rules and Regulation of the LGC provides: ARTICLE 131. Administrative Appeals. — Decisions in administrative cases may, within thirty (30) days from receipt thereof, be appealed to the following: (a) The sangguniang panlalawigan, in the case of decisions of the sangguniang panlungsod of component cities and the sangguniang bayan; and (c) If no appeal is made within thirty (30) days from receipt of the decision, the decision shall become final and executory. (emphasis ours)

As gleaned from the provisions of the LGC and its IRR, it is clear that the parties are given thirty (30) days reglementary period to file an appeal. The said period is part of the due process afforded to the parties. The Supreme Court in plethora of cases said that "the essence of due process in administrative proceedings is simply the opportunity to explain one's side or to seek a reconsideration Of the action or ruling cemplained of. Furthermore, the counsel's actions and mistakes on procedural matters bind the client. Where the party has the opportunity tQ_ appeal or seek reconsideretion of the Cadena vs. CSCG.R. No. 191412, January 17.2012 action or rulin m lain d T defec i rocedura cured. "I(Emphasis ours) ess ma In the herein case, applying the provisions of law cited-above, the Decision of the higher Sanggunian shall become final albeit executory after the reglementary period of appeal has been exhausted, that is, thirty (30) days from the receipt of the aggrieved parties of the Decision. Hence, before that period is exhausted, the Decision of the lower Sanggunian is still executory. Be that as it may, for purposes of discussion, since the Decision was rendered on 19 July 2017, received by the Office of the Mayor on 21 July 2017, and assumed that on that date it was also received by the parties, and where no appeal was taken therefrom, then the Decision of the Sangguniang Panlalawigan will become final and executory after the lapse thirty (30) days from 21 July 2017. On the other hand, if the other party appealed the said Decision, example on the 25 July 2017, then from that date, the decision of the Sangguniang Panlalawigan shall be executory pending appeal to the Office of the President. Lastly, when this query was referred (emailed) to this Office on 7 September 2017, and whether or not there is an appeal taken by the aggrieved party, the Decision of the Sangguniang Panlalawigan has already become executory because of the lapse of the thirty (30)-day reglementary period provided by the law, and Mayor De Guzman II should implement the Decision. We hope we have guided you accordingly. Very truly yours, F THE SECRETARY: BY AUTHORI AUSTERE A. PANADERO Undersecretary I.Y'37
